notes: PLACEHOLDER, NOT MEASURED: 5 of 5 venues (measured=false) are hand-written shapes of the hourly pattern Google Popular Times typically shows for the venue type, not data for these venues. They cannot validate the sim: calibration error and report confidence must leave them out.

Scale: 0-100 = share of the venue's busiest hour of the week (Popular Times scale). weekday = mean of the Mon-Fri calendar days, weekend = Sat-Sun; an hour after midnight belongs to the next calendar day (Fri 01:00 counts as Saturday), as in StoreStats.
s5 Quaker Street Coffee & Bubble Tea (cafe) is the cafe nearest the station; placeholder (weekday commuter rush 08-10 and lunch, weekend brunch peak 11-14).
s10 The Knave of Clubs (restaurant) is the restaurant nearest the station; placeholder (lunch 12-14 and a bigger dinner peak 19-21, busiest on Saturday).
s18 Shoreditch House (bar) is the bar nearest the station; placeholder (after-work rise from 17:00, latest and busiest on Friday and Saturday nights).
c1 Little Fires (club) is the club nearest Dumbo Shoreditch; placeholder (open Thu-Sat 22:00-03:00, peak 01-02 on Friday and Saturday nights).
s13 Dumbo Shoreditch (takeaway) is the takeaway nearest a club (Little Fires, 49 m); placeholder (lunch, dinner 18-21 and an after-club peak 02-04 on Friday and Saturday nights).
Popular Times needs a paid API key: BESTTIME_API_KEY and OUTSCRAPER_API_KEY are not set (SerpAPI is key-gated too and not wired in), so no venue was measured.

London Datastore checked 2026-10-15 (all 1306 datasets): no open hourly high-street footfall for Shoreditch, Hackney or Tower Hamlets. Closest: Google Mobility by Borough (daily % change, All Rights Reserved, ended Oct 2022), the COVID-19 Mobility Report footfall series (daily, London-wide) and LTDS 'Trips made in London by time of day' (London-wide weekday trip starts). GLA High Streets Data Service footfall is not in the open catalogue (only its boundaries, dataset 2rq4w).
